# Doofinder

> > Doofinder provides intelligent search and discovery solutions for eCommerce platforms, helping online stores optimize product findability and increase conversions.

Doofinder specializes in internal site search technology for eCommerce, offering integrations with platforms like PrestaShop, customizable search interfaces, and conversion optimization tools. The site provides extensive resources on digital marketing, eCommerce best practices, and technical implementation guides.

## Key Topics

- eCommerce search optimization
- Conversion rate optimization
- PrestaShop integration
- Internal site search
- Digital marketing strategies
- Product catalog management
- Buyer persona development
- Search layer customization
- Data feed configuration
- No results page optimization
- Social proof tactics
- Lead scoring
- SEO for eCommerce
- YouTube Ads for online stores
- Return policy optimization

## Doofinder Product & Features

- [Tipos de diseño de la búsqueda | Doofinder](https://www.doofinder.com/es/product/design-types): Doofinder search design options: fullscreen, floating, embedded layouts
- [Solicita una DEMO de Doofinder - Doofinder](https://www.doofinder.com/es/request-demo): Request a demo of Doofinder eCommerce search solution

- [Integrar la capa de Doofinder con el carrito de tu tienda](https://www.doofinder.com/es/blog/integrar-la-capa-con-el-carrito): Integrate Doofinder layer with shopping cart using Javascript
